points.description: States the name of the function as part of the signature. Equivalent wording such as 'the identifier of the function' earns the mark.

States the types of the parameters as part of the signature. Equivalent wording such as 'the data types of the arguments' or 'the parameter types, in order' earns the mark. Naming only the parameters, without their types, does not earn this mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both the function's name and the types of its parameters. Each idea is worth 2.5 marks and is all-or-nothing. Do not award marks for return type or other items the model answer does not mention, and do not penalise their presence as long as both required items are present.
